text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres seeks referendum on changes to abortion law.
- Somague in talks with view to buying all or part of construction interests of A.Silva e Silva.
- Porto chairman Pinto da Costa cleared by police over accusations that the club paid for a leading referee to take a holiday in Brazil in 1995.
- Propane prices to rise by nine percent in Portugal from February 1.

- Financing for construction of Oporto metro could be frozen. The European Union seeks clarifications from the Sociedade do Metro do Porto after complaints of unfair treatment from consortia which lost bidding to build the metro.
- Excess pulp production is discouraging any increase in prices, a broker's analyst tells the paper.
